page_summary: This page contains two figures related to cybersecurity in ports. Figure 21 illustrates the use of Security Operations Centers (SOC) across different income levels, showing responses regarding whether organizations operate an SOC internally, outsource it, or do not use one. Figure 22 presents the integration of automated cybersecurity solutions, detailing responses on whether such solutions are integrated into systems across the same income categories.

regions.label: Figure 21
regions.description: Bar chart showing the percentage of responses regarding the operation of Security Operations Centers (SOC) across different income levels: High income, Upper-middle income, Lower-middle income, and Low income. Categories include 'Yes - internally operated', 'Yes - outsourced', 'No', and 'Prefer not to say'.

regions.label: Figure 22
regions.description: Bar chart illustrating the integration of automated cybersecurity solutions across income levels. Categories include 'Yes', 'No', 'Not sure', and 'Prefer not to say'.
